description: This file contains unit tests for the RuntimeLocator component of the OpenClaw project, specifically testing the resolution of runtime versions through temporary scripts and various failure scenarios.

classes.name: RuntimeLocatorTests
classes.description: A struct encapsulating multiple test cases for verifying runtime location and version parsing logic.

methods.name: makeTempExecutable
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory and file with specified contents, sets executable permissions, and returns the file URL.

methods.name: `resolve succeeds with valid node`
methods.description: Test that resolves runtime version successfully when the node script outputs a valid version.

methods.name: `resolve fails on boundary below minimum`
methods.description: Test that fails resolution when the node script outputs a version below the minimum supported version.

methods.name: `resolve fails when too old`
methods.description: Test that fails resolution when the node script outputs an older, unsupported version.

methods.name: `resolve fails when version unparsable`
methods.description: Test that handles parse errors when version string cannot be parsed.

methods.name: `describe failure includes paths`
methods.description: Test that failure messages accurately include searched paths.

methods.name: `runtime version parses with leading V and metadata`
methods.description: Test parsing of version strings with leading 'v' and metadata segments.
